oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.prTitle: OAuth credential sync and app integration enhancements

comentarios.texto: WHAT: Single static header comparison gates overwrite of any userId/appSlug credential keys with decrypted attacker-influenced JSON. WHY: Anyone holding the shared secret can overwrite any user's third-party OAuth keys, hijacking calendar/video access with no per-user auth, HMAC, replay protection, or rate limit. HOW: See improvedCode; at minimum require HMAC-signed body with timestamp.

The comment requires 32 bytes for AES256 but the generation command `openssl rand -base64 24` produces only 24 bytes, so a user following the docs creates a key that disagrees with the documented requirement and will fail/shorten encryption. Change the command to `openssl rand -base64 32`.

WHAT: The "lost_access"/"go_back" toggle Button inside the disable <Form> has no type="button" so it acts as a submit. WHY: Clicking it toggles the view and simultaneously fires handleDisable with stale/empty codes, causing spurious disable attempts and confusing error states. HOW: Add type="button" to the toggle (and cancel) buttons inside the Form.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.head: d1c69189f3c90ecf56013a8da904da9bff9a8e19
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.prTitle: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding

comentarios.texto: WHAT: record_for_host returns false on failure but callers use eh.try(:category_id), and try only guards nil so false.try(:category_id) dispatches to FalseClass and raises. WHY: TopicEmbed.import (app/models/topic_embed.rb:36-43) crashes on malformed/unknown embed URLs instead of handling nil category. HOW: return nil instead of false consistently.

WHAT: every embed comment/retriever check now does a SELECT via record_for_host instead of the previous in-memory SiteSetting string check. WHY: adds a DB round-trip to the hot unauthenticated embed path on every request, increasing latency and DB load. HOW: cache the host list with expiry and invalidate on EmbeddableHost save/destroy.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.prTitle: FIX: proper handling of group memberships

comentarios.texto: Next clamps to user_count, which is past the last page when count is a multiple of limit (e.g. count 100, limit 50, offset 50 -> 100 empty). Clamp to (totalPages-1)*limit instead.

plugins-chore-renamed-instrumentation-mi.head: 303cdc2caf256aa5df660611120c2e3f7392365d
plugins-chore-renamed-instrumentation-mi.prTitle: Plugins: Chore: Renamed instrumentation middleware to metrics middleware

comentarios.texto: WHAT: QueryData ranges over req.Queries and CallResource reads len(req.Body) without nil-req guards. WHY: A nil request panics where LoggerMiddleware explicitly delegates nil requests to next. HOW: Add if req == nil { return m.next.X(...) } guards matching LoggerMiddleware.

Missing nil-request guard causes panic: QueryData dereferences req.Queries, CallResource dereferences req.Body, CheckHealth/CollectMetrics dereference req.PluginContext. LoggerMiddleware in the same chain guards req==nil, proving nil is reachable. Add if req==nil passthrough before instrumenting, matching LoggerMiddleware.

WHAT: Loader now maps only promResponse rules and dropped matchRules Creating/Deleting handling. WHY: Transient deleting rules (prom-only) render as normal rows with full Edit/More actions instead of Deleting state without actions, and creating rules vanish. HOW: Restore operation-aware rendering for prom-only rows or filter/suppress actions while ruler/prom diverge.
Optional chain stops at .rules, so empty groups yields undefined.map() throw. Default to empty array: (groups.at(0)?.rules ?? []).map(...).

Comment states location is redundant in folder>group hierarchy but no showLocation={false} is passed and GrafanaRuleListItem defaults to true, so grouped rules show location contrary to declared intent.

implement-access-token-context-encoding-.head: daffb05b5ad091d3ec09933c3c99c2b54f448696
implement-access-token-context-encoding-.prTitle: Implement access token context encoding framework

comentarios.texto: WHAT: initToken unconditionally encodes the ID and encodeTokenId throws IllegalStateException for any grantType with no registered shortcut. WHY: Custom/extension grants or any flow setting an unmapped grant string turn previously-successful token issuance into a 500 error. HOW: Fall back to rawTokenId (or UNKNOWN shortcut) when no shortcut is mapped instead of throwing.

fix-concurrent-group-access-to-prevent-n.head: 4def149a50c4b9b2c24fbb753ac60fe4f4df0cac
fix-concurrent-group-access-to-prevent-n.prTitle: Fix concurrent group access to prevent NullPointerException

comentarios.texto: WHAT: Reader thread busy-spins full listings with maxResults=Integer.MAX_VALUE and no throttle. WHY: Each iteration loads all groups with no pagination/backoff, creating unbounded request fanout and server load that can starve the deleter and destabilize the suite. HOW: Bound the page size and add backoff/yield between iterations.

add-client-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.head: 1950a511026d520a7329c7b6b9ee60a4af8f8b55
add-client-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.prTitle: Add Client resource type and scopes to authorization schema

comentarios.texto: WHAT: canMapRoles/canMapCompositeRoles/canMapClientScopeRoles only check fine-grained permission and never check MANAGE_CLIENTS role, unlike canManage/canManageClientScopes siblings. WHY: A realm admin with manage-clients (or existing V1 behavior) is incorrectly denied role-mapping on clients, breaking the implied-admin contract.

WHAT: setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError sets USERNAME_HIDDEN/REGISTRATION_DISABLED on a fresh context.form() instance that is then discarded before rendering. WHY: callers (AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator.badPasswordHandler before challenge(), WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.createErrorResponse before fillContextForm()+errorChallenge) each obtain new LoginFormsProvider instances to render, so the re-auth error page loses hidden-username state and falls back to regular login form. HOW: thread the same LoginFormsProvider instance through — set the attributes on the form used by challenge/fill/errorChallenge instead of calling context.form() inside the helper.

WHAT: base `sync_status_outbound` adds explicit `assignment_source` param but `ExampleIntegration.sync_status_outbound(self, external_issue, is_resolved, project_id)` accepts no **kwargs. WHY: any caller passing `assignment_source=` to that installation raises TypeError, breaking the override contract. HOW: keep the new param absorbed via **kwargs on the base or update all overrides to accept it.

advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.head: ee38fd295fd294b9fc787eba482bde24bbfea69b
advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.prTitle: Advanced date override handling and timezone compatibility improvements

comentarios.texto: Execution break: truthy check guards undefined but not an invalid/unknown organizerTimeZone string; dayjs.tz() throws on invalid zone inside dateOverrides.find(), aborting checkIfIsAvailable/getSchedule. Validate against known zones or try/catch with fallback to 0.

feat-add-calendar-cache-status-and-actio.head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
feat-add-calendar-cache-status-and-actio.prTitle: feat: add calendar cache status and actions (#22532)

comentarios.texto: WHAT: handler directly instantiates CalendarCacheRepository instead of the calendar-cache.ts factory that returns CalendarCacheRepositoryMock when disabled. WHY: when calendar-cache is disabled it still issues prisma.calendarCache.groupBy and can expose status inconsistent with the rest of the app. HOW: resolve the repository through the existing factory that respects isCalendarCacheEnabledGlobally.

WHAT: fixed /tmp/tmole.log combined with rm -f and shell redirect follows symlinks. WHY: a local attacker pre-creating /tmp/tmole.log as a symlink causes truncation/overwrite of an arbitrary victim-owned file when the script runs. HOW: create the log with mktemp and avoid predictable paths.

add-comprehensive-email-validation-for-b.head: 5f8a130277dbddc95d133cd2832be639baf89213
add-comprehensive-email-validation-for-b.prTitle: Add comprehensive email validation for blocked users

comentarios.texto: Comment claims last_match_at indicates 'have ever been blocked', but BlockedEmail.should_block? updates match_count/last_match_at for every match including action_type :do_nothing (proven by shared examples for both :block and :do_nothing). A do_nothing hit sets last_match_at without blocking, so the prose is untrue. Fix the comment to say matched/seen, not blocked.

ux-show-complete-url-path-if-website-dom.head: 267d8be1f556ed59639ced396c885bb44586da19
ux-show-complete-url-path-if-website-dom.prTitle: UX: show complete URL path if website domain is same as instance domain

comentarios.texto: WHAT: URI without a scheme has nil host, so website_name returns nil even when website is present. WHY: The template gates on {{#if model.website_name}}, so a stored value like example.com/user disappears instead of showing fallback host text. HOW: Normalize by prepending a scheme before parsing when host is nil, or fall back to the raw website value.

WHAT: Same-domain display concatenates only host + path, discarding query and fragment. WHY: A website like http://example.com/user?ref=x displays as example.com/user, losing distinguishing information and mismatching the href. HOW: Append query/fragment (e.g. use request_uri) when present.

WHAT: Switching from interpolateVariablesInQueries to applyTemplateVariables drops the datasource:getRef() assignment. WHY: Old method (datasource.ts:436-438) stamped each query with datasource ref; new method (datasource.ts:1135-1140) returns only expr/step/legendFormat, leaving stale/missing datasource on split targets for downstream routing. HOW: Preserve the datasource ref when mapping, as the old path did.

Name NewInMemoryDB promises the working in-memory DB callers in parser.go and sql_command.go expect from duck.NewInMemoryDB, but the new type holds no state and every method returns 'not implemented'. Rename to reflect stub status (e.g. NewStubDB/NewDisabledDB) or document that it is intentionally unimplemented so callers are not misled.

WHAT: MaxCount cleanup fetches victim IDs with LIMIT/OFFSET then deletes them in a separate statement with no transaction. WHY: Concurrent deletion of newer rows between fetch and delete shifts the OFFSET window, so a fetched ID can slide back into the top-MaxCount set that must be kept yet still gets deleted. HOW: Re-check membership or perform the delete atomically if exact MaxCount retention is required.

add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.head: 7355f05e6aafe2a7acc6434fb40c686665416606
add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.prTitle: Add Groups resource type and scopes to authorization schema

comentarios.texto: WHAT: canView(user)/canManage(user) dropped ADMIN role from hasOneAdminRole check. WHY: Admins relying on ADMIN role lose view/manage access (denial) diverging from prior contract and V1 behavior. HOW: Restore AdminRoles.ADMIN in the role checks or prove ADMIN is handled elsewhere.

feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.head: 9966ec5a13e331659c3ea00981f9b11b0faf821f
feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.prTitle: feat(uptime): Add ability to use queues to manage parallelism

comentarios.texto: WHAT: _get_partition_lock reads/writes partition_locks dict without any global lock, so two threads adding a new partition can create two different Lock objects. WHY: Threads then guard add_offset/complete_offset/get_committable with different locks, breaking mutual exclusion and corrupting all_offsets/outstanding commit decisions. HOW: Guard lock creation with a global lock for partition_locks.

SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy.submit passes FilteredPayload to decoder and expects None to skip+commit. The wired decoder partial(self.decode_payload,...) asserts not isinstance(payload, FilteredPayload), so filtered messages raise AssertionError into the generic except instead of the intended None fast-path (error log + reliance on exception fallback). Guard FilteredPayload before delegating to decode_payload.

optimize-spans-buffer-insertion-with-evi.head: eb9623b4e787303a3bd15e10bbbdb78d59875ac6
optimize-spans-buffer-insertion-with-evi.prTitle: Optimize spans buffer insertion with eviction during insert

comentarios.texto: WHAT: Untrusted SDK-controlled end_timestamp_precise is used verbatim as the ZSET score driving ZPOPMIN eviction. WHY: An attacker can send far-future timestamps to pin their spans and force eviction of legitimate spans in the same segment, biasing sampling/storage. HOW: Validate/clamp the score server-side instead of trusting client time.

WHAT: Every span insert runs up to two ZUNIONSTORE full copies of the up-to-1000-member set plus ZCARD/ZPOPMIN. WHY: Building a segment span-by-span copies O(N) per insert, i.e. O(N^2) total per segment and O(B*N) per batch in the ingest hot path. HOW: Merge once per batch or skip union when keys are already joined.
